evidence.claim: Project policy creation is denied for current owner. The ingress restriction is set at the parent organization; project and intermediate folder have no local override.

evidence.claim: Organization Policy Administrator includes the missing policy-write permissions and has 26 permissions in the live predefined role. The lowest grant scope for the predefined role is organization.

All five queried relevant permission records were found after visiting 12000 metadata entries. Policy create/update/delete/set are onlyInPredefinedRoles true and NOT_SUPPORTED in custom roles. Project-custom-role remedy is unsupported; the metadata query was partial, not a full namespace inventory.
Conditional IAM role bindings support expiry via request.time < timestamp. Organization getIamPolicy/setIamPolicy are the required permissions. Existing unrelated bindings must be preserved.
